finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.InvalidOrOverflowing: Original nonfinite/negative/zero input and arithmetic overflow/underflow refusals; represented scaling, dark source and no partial published values.
finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.MovingObserverUsesBa: Original beta=.6/gamma1.25, three source directions and both map parities; independent Lorentz g/area relation and2048-interval two-node quadrature verify band gain times1/absolute angular Jacobian exactly once.
finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.ReferenceFrequencyPr: Original eight catalogue temperatures100..1e6K; reference frequency colour/linear flux-density agreement, adjacent-unit-frequency continuity and original finite-difference smoothness checks.
finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.RejectsReciprocalExt: Original6500K,g=.5/2 fixtures reject reciprocal frequency, extra g^4, shifted normalization and truncating the source band, by original100-times-tolerance separation.
finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.ShiftedSpectrumMatch: Original3temperatures3000/6500/20000K times4frequency factors. Independent long-double g^5 B_lambda(g lambda,T) reference; original32-bin band response,8192 Simpson/direct identity and4096-to8192 refinement bounds; original2e-6 colour budget.
finite_acceptance_scope.PointSourceTransfer.ShiftedTemperatureHa: Original three shifted-temperature fixtures, bright-source recovery below binary32, represented hot and underflow cases; unchanged finite sample assertions.

reference.derivation_scope: g^5 B_lambda(g lambda,T)=B_lambda(lambda,gT) at fixed observed band; normalize by original source-temperature catalogue factor, then multiply catalogue flux and detector density once. Independent Lorentz angular area is distinct from fixed-band gain; no additional bolometric g^4.
reference.independent_reference: tests/support/point_source_band_reference.h reimplements defining Planck equation with exact SI h,c,k and long-double arithmetic; no call to production Planck/colour/transfer helpers. Original matching-function coefficients and rational XYZ/RGB matrix express the same defined fits; this is not an independent all-wavelength CIE-table accuracy claim.

nist_2022.precision_note: h, c and k are exact SI defining constants. Listed sigma and wavelength Wien b have ellipses: source 5.670374419e-8 and 2.897771955e-3 retain their existing truncated decimal representations of exact-derived quantities, not new exact finite decimals.
